children: may extend its bounce to $4,316 per ounce, as suggested by a falling channel and a projection analysis.

The bounce is assumed to be the same degree as the one from $4,291 to $4,371. A projection analysis on the fall from $4,370 reveals the 50% level of $4,316 as the target, which is pointed by the channel at the same time.
A break below $4,162 could confirm the continuation of the downtrend toward the $4,194-$4,219 range.
